headlines.description: Hull and Millwall battled out a tense goalless draw in Friday's Sky Bet Championship playoff semifinal first leg.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull, Millwall goalless in playoff SF first leg

headlines.description: Southampton parked 'spygate' and survived an early onslaught against aggrieved Middlesbrough as a pulsating first leg of this Sky Bet Championship play-off semifinal somehow ended 0-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints, Boro play out goalless draw amid 'spygate'

notes.text: 2nd Leg - Hull City advance 2-0 on aggregate
notes.headline: 2nd Leg - Hull City advance 2-0 on aggregate

headlines.description: Substitutes Mohamed Belloumi and Joe Gelhardt ended Millwall's Premier League dream as Hull City reached the Championship playoff final.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull beat Millwall late to reach playoff final

headlines.description: Shea Charles struck a fortuitous extra-time winner as Southampton ensured the 'spygate' scandal will rumble on by booking their place in the Championship play-off final with a dramatic 2-1 comeback victory over Middlesbrough.
headlines.shortLinkText: S'oton win in extra-time to reach playoff final

headlines.description: Hull City emerged from the chaos of the Championship playoffs to beat Middlesbrough in the 'spygate' final at Wembley and seal a return to the Premier League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull promoted to Premier League after Boro win
